The Content Marketing Manager is a creative storyteller and digital content strategist responsible for producing compelling, mission-driven content that advances Planned Parenthood of Greater New York’s mission, brand, advocacy, and fundraising goals.

This role develops and executes engaging content across social media, video, email, web, and emerging digital platforms to connect with patients, supporters, donors, activists, organizers, and community partners.

Working closely with colleagues across the organization, the Content Marketing Manager transforms complex issues, timely news, and community stories into impactful digital experiences that inspire action, build trust, and deepen engagement in support of sexual and reproductive health care, education, and rights.
This person is a highly creative content creator who thrives in fast-paced digital environments and has a passion for social media, video storytelling, and audience engagement. They bring a strong understanding of platform trends, content performance, and digital culture, pairing creativity with data-informed decision-making to create content that expands reach, strengthens community, and advances PPGNY’s mission.

Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing, the Content Marketing Manager oversees digital components of the communications and marketing plan that fulfill PPGNY’s organizational mission, vision, values, business, and fundraising goals

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

We're looking for a Social Media and Content Marketing Manager to own the channels where Flexport shows up every day. You'll run our social presence, keep the blog full of content people actually want to read, and produce a newsletter that logistics leaders look forward to opening. You'll write most of it yourself, polish the visuals in Canva, cut short videos for social, and build a network of voices, inside Flexport and out, who amplify our story.
This is a hands-on job for a strong writer who gets social, has an eye for design, and likes shipping work rather than just planning it.
You will
Own Flexport's owned social channels day to day across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram: plan the calendar, write the posts, publish, engage, and report on what's working.
Write and edit blog content that turns complex supply chain topics into pieces people finish and share, from thought leadership to customer stories to product updates.
Produce our newsletter end to end, from picking the stories to writing the copy to hitting send.
Design social graphics and light marketing assets in Canva, staying true to Flexport's brand.
Edit short-form video for social, including cutting clips, adding captions, and packaging them for each platform.
Build our influencer network on both sides: coach internal experts and executives to post with confidence, and cultivate relationships with external creators and industry voices.
Track performance across channels and use what you learn to make the next post, article, and newsletter better.
You should have
5+ years in social media, content marketing, or a closely related role.
Genuinely strong writing. You can take a dense logistics topic and make it clear, sharp, and worth reading.
Hands-on experience managing owned media channels, including LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
A working command of social best practices across those platforms, from what to post to when and why, and how each channel differs.
Basic design editing skills. You're comfortable building clean, on-brand graphics in Canva.
Basic video editing skills. You can cut and caption short clips for social without needing a full production team.
Comfort managing several channels and deadlines at once, with the ownership to keep them all moving.
Bonus: experience building creator or influencer programs, or working in B2B, logistics, or tech.

Conversica is seeking a hands-on Content Marketing Manager to help drive awareness, engagement, and market presence through compelling content, marketing programs, and brand storytelling.
This role is responsible for creating, managing, and executing external marketing initiatives that support company growth and visibility. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, storyteller, and marketing generalist who can independently turn ideas into polished marketing assets and maintain a consistent marketing presence across channels.
This is an individual contributor role focused on execution rather than people management. The successful candidate will work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create content, manage website updates, support marketing campaigns, and help bring Conversica's story to market.
This is a remote role based in the United States.

Content Creation & Storytelling
Create and manage blogs, articles, customer stories, case studies, thought leadership content, and industry-focused content.
Partner with leadership and subject matter experts to transform ideas and expertise into compelling external content.
Develop content that supports company messaging, market positioning, and business priorities.
Maintain an editorial calendar and content roadmap.
Website & Digital Presence
Manage and maintain website content, including page updates, landing pages, messaging updates, and content publishing.
Help ensure website content remains current, relevant, and aligned with company priorities.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors as needed to support website enhancements and improvements.
Marketing Campaigns & Brand Execution
Coordinate and execute marketing campaigns across digital channels.
Support product launches, announcements, webinars, events, and other marketing initiatives.
Create and maintain marketing assets that support awareness, engagement, and lead generation efforts.
Help ensure consistency of messaging, branding, and visual presentation across customer-facing channels.
Customer & Industry Marketing
Develop customer success stories and use cases that highlight business outcomes and customer value.
Create content that supports industry awareness and thought leadership.
Identify opportunities to amplify customer wins, company milestones, and market insights.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with leadership, sales, customer success, product, and other teams to identify content opportunities and marketing priorities.
Coordinate marketing efforts across departments to ensure timely execution and alignment.
Serve as a marketing resource for company-wide initiatives requiring external communications and content support.

Required
5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, content marketing, or related marketing roles.
Exceptional written communication, editing, and storytelling skills.
Experience creating content in partnership with subject matter experts and executive leaders.
Experience managing website content and digital marketing initiatives.
Ability to independently manage multiple projects and priorities.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Experience in SaaS, AI, technology, automotive, or related industries.
